title: Canyon Charge
description: Collect glowing Power Cells through a vast sunlit canyon in a fast low-poly arcade racer, then spend stored charges on a high-impact boost. Race AI rivals, battle a friend in split-screen, build tracks in Track Lab, or chase online ghosts.

defaultCaptions.x: Collect Power Cells mid-race, bank up to three charges, and spend them on a gold Power Boost through a giant sunlit canyon. Play Canyon Charge in your browser.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Canyon Charge is a fast low-poly arcade racer: collect Power Cells during three-lap races, then spend stored charges for a high-impact boost. Race AI rivals, a friend in split-screen, or online ghosts.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Canyon Charge — a browser arcade racer with Power Cells, stored boost charges, drift lines, ramps and fair counterplay items. Solo, split-screen, Track Lab and online ghosts.
defaultCaptions.discord: Race me in Canyon Charge! Collect Power Cells, bank three charges, and fire a Power Boost through the canyon.
